Bill.BriefDescription: Extending a wildlife crop damage reimbursement program.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to wildlife crop damage; amending 2001 c 274 s 5(uncodified); and providing an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: 2001 c 274 s 5 (uncodified) is amended to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The following expire June 30, ((2004)) 2008: (1) Section 1, chapter 274, Laws of 2001; (2) Section 2, chapter 274, Laws of 2001; and (3) Section 3, chapter 274, Laws of 2001.
